subject: general
question: Shri Pramod Sawant took the oath as the Chief Minister of which state in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Pramod Sawant** took the oath as the **Chief Minister of Goa** in **March 2022.**
 
• **Goa is a state located in western India, known for its beaches, nightlife, and Portuguese influence.**
 
• **Shri P.S. Sreedharan Pillai **was sworn in as the** 22nd governor **of the State of Goa on July 15, 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra** is the** second-most populous** state in India and is known for its capital city **Mumbai.**

 
 
• Since **30 June 2022, Eknath Sambhaji Shinde** has been Maharashtra's **20th and current chief minister.**
 
 
 
• **Gujarat **is the** birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi **and has a strong industrial sector.
 
 
• **Since 2021, Bhupendra Rajnikant Patel has been Gujarat's 17th and current chief minister.**
 
 
 
• **Karnataka** is known for its **historical sites, natural beauty, **and** IT industry.**
 
 
• Since 2023, **Siddaramaiah** has been Karnataka's **22nd chief minister.**
